source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "smart urbanism" OR "actually existing smart city" OR "Smart Cities Mission"
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"smart urbanism" OR "actually existing smart city" OR "Smart Cities Mission",is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("Smart Cities Mission" OR "actually existing smart city" OR "smart urbanism")
